race.description: The Valley @ Southside Pakenham Mdn Plate
race.comment: STAR JE TAIME (10) sets the standard after being beaten a nose at Mornington as a short odds-on favourite, with interference near the 500m adding context to the defeat. She had also been held up when third at Kyneton, so her recent form has more merit than the bare results, and first-time blinkers give her another chance to turn consistency into a maiden win. AMBITION IN BLOOM (7) is the clear danger after finishing just over half a length away in the same Mornington race, having led to the turn before being run down late. Can improve again. VIA THERESA (11) is a possible improver third up. KUHEYLAN (2) comes back from metro company and has been close up at her past two. In the mix.
